mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO qs_winner ( user_id, draw_id, prize_id, winner_code_id, user_name, avatar ) VALUES
( #{item.userId}, #{item.drawId}, #{item.prizeId}, #{item.winnerCodeId}, #{item.userName}, #{item.avatar} )
mapper.select: SELECT w.user_name AS userName, w.avatar, p.prize_name AS prizeName, p.prize_type AS prizeType, dc.code_value AS codeValue FROM qs_winner w LEFT JOIN qs_prize p ON p.prize_id = w.prize_id LEFT JOIN qs_draw_code dc ON dc.draw_code_id = w.winner_code_id WHERE w.draw_id = #{drawId} ORDER BY p.prize_type ASC
